perks.name: The Fourth Magic
perks.description: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy. When you have Death Throes and throw a grenade, nearby allies gain greatly increased grenade regeneration for a short time.

item.name: Harmonic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
